name: com.socketlist/socketlist
title: Socketlist
description: Search scored MCP servers; get score breakdowns, setup snippets and allowlist entries.

tools.name: search_servers
tools.description: Search Socketlist's scored MCP servers by keyword (e.g. "postgres", "browser automation", "jira"). Results are ordered by how well they match, then by Socketlist score (0-100), then GitHub stars. Leave query empty with a category to list the top servers in that category.

query.description: Keywords to match against server names, titles and descriptions. Optional when category is set.

category.description: Only return servers in this category.

min_score.description: Only return servers scoring at least this much (every listed server scores 70+).

remote_only.description: Only return servers that offer a hosted (remote) endpoint.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Get one server's Socketlist score with its maintenance/security/adoption breakdown and flags, the signals behind it (stars, last push, licence, security policy), install commands, setup snippets for Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code, declared environment variables, an allowedMcpServers allowlist entry, and scored alternatives. Accepts a registry name (io.github.owner/repo), a Socketlist slug, an exact title or a socketlist.com URL.

server.description: Registry name, Socketlist slug, exact title, or socketlist.com/server/... URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Socketlist's categories with how many scored servers each has and the top three by score. Use a category key with search_servers.
